chunks: Ahmad b. Muhammad b. Yahya al-Attar (may Allah have mercy on him) narrated to us. He said: My father narrated to us from Yaqub b. Yazid, from Muhammad b. Abi Umayr, from Sayf b. Amira, from Ashath b. Suwar, from al-Ahnaf b. Qays, from Abu Dharr al-Ghifari (may Allah have mercy on him). He said:

One day, we were with the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and his family) in the Quba Mosque, and we were a group of his companions, when he said: O my companions! A man who is the Commander of the Faithful and the Imam of the Muslims will enter upon you through this door. He said: So they looked, and I was among those who looked. Then, we saw Ali b. Abi Talib (peace be upon him) come through the door. So the Prophet (may Allah bless him and his family) stood up, received him, embraced him, and kissed his forehead. He brought him and seated him at his side. Then he turned to us with his noble face and said: This is your Imam after me. Obedience to him is obedience to me, and disobedience to him is disobedience to me; and obedience to me is obedience to Allah, and disobedience to me is disobedience to Allah, the Mighty and Majestic.

key_terms.أمير المؤمنين: Amir al-Mu'minin - Commander of the Faithful, a title specific to Imam Ali (as)
key_terms.إمام المسلمين: Imam al-Muslimin - Imam of the Muslims, indicating religious and political leadership
key_terms.طاعة: Ta'a - Obedience; the hadith establishes a chain of obedience linking Ali to the Prophet and the Prophet to God
key_terms.معصية: Ma'siya - Disobedience; violation of the obedience chain established by the Prophet

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet Muhammad say about Ali being the Commander of the Faithful at Quba Mosque?
ai.summary: Abu Dharr al-Ghifari narrates that the Prophet (s) explicitly designated Ali b. Abi Talib (as) as the Commander of the Faithful and Imam of the Muslims at the Quba Mosque in Medina. The Prophet's announcement was made before a group of his companions, and he physically received Ali with great honor before declaring that obedience to Ali is equivalent to obedience to the Prophet, and ultimately to obedience to God. This narration is significant in Shia theology as it establishes the direct appointment (nass) of Ali as the Prophet's successor.

en.bilal-muhammad: Ahmad b. Muhammad b. Yahya al-`Attar (rh) narrated to us. He said: My father narrated to us from Ya`qub b. Yazid from Muhammad b. Abi `Umayr from Sayf b. `Amira from Ash`ath b. Siwear from al-Ahnaf b. Qays from Abi Dharr al-Ghifari (rh). He said:

One day, we were with the Messenger of Allah (s) in the Quba Mosque. We were with a group of his companions when he said: O my companions! A man who is the Commander of the Faithful and the Imam of the Muslims will come to you through this door. He said: So, they looked, and I looked too. Then, we saw `Ali b. Abi Talib (as) come through the door. So, the Prophet (s) stood, embraced him, and kissed his forehead. He came with him until he sat him to his side. Then, he turned to us with his blessed face and said: This is your Imam after me. Obedience to him is obedience to me, and disobedience to him is disobedience to me; and obedience to me is obedience to Allah, and disobedience to me is disobedience to Allah.
